reset.subject: Reset your Oh, You Shouldn't! password
reset.intro: You requested a password reset. Use the button below to choose a new password. This link is valid for 1 hour.
reset.openLink: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:
reset.ignore: If you didn’t request this, you can ignore this email.

already.subject: This address already has an Oh, You Shouldn't! account
already.intro: Someone tried to create an account with this address. If it was you, log in. Otherwise, ignore this email.
already.ignore: If you didn’t try to sign up, you can ignore this email. Your password has not changed.

invite.subject: You’re invited to join a list on Oh, You Shouldn't!
invite.intro: You’ve been invited to join “{{listTitle}}” and help manage it. Log in or create an account to continue.
invite.openLink: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:
invite.ctaHint: an Oh, You Shouldn't! account is required
invite.ignore: If you weren’t expecting this, ignore it.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address — Oh, You Shouldn't!
verify.intro: Welcome! To finish creating your account, confirm your email address with the button below. This link is valid for 24 hours.
verify.openLink: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:
verify.ignore: If you didn’t create an account, you can ignore this email.

change.subject: Confirm your new address — Oh, You Shouldn't!
change.intro: You asked to sign in with this address. Confirm it with the button below: it will replace your current address. This link is valid for 24 hours.
change.openLink: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:
change.ignore: If you didn’t ask for this, ignore this email: nothing will change.

changed.subject: Your sign-in address has changed — Oh, You Shouldn't!
changed.intro: Your account's sign-in address is now {{newEmail}}. This address can no longer be used to sign in.
changed.notYou: If you didn’t make this change, write to us as soon as possible at {{contact}} from this address: we will help you get your account back.
